_comment: Live-action tool definitions for the Sarvam Voice Agents platform. Set base_url to the deployed service and send the shared secret in the x-api-key header on every call. The platform's call id should be forwarded as x-trace-id so telephony and tool logs share one identifier. Identity uses two factors: verify_identity locates the record and issues a passcode, verify_otp proves possession of the registered mobile.

session_bootstrap._comment: Call once when the call connects. Store session_id and pass it to every subsequent tool.

tools.name: verify_identity
tools.description: Look up the caller's record and send a passcode to their registered contact. Call this before anything else. Returns 'otp_sent' when the record was found and a code is on its way, 'not_registered' when no account exists for that PAN (the caller is a prospect, not a failed customer), 'retry' when details did not match and an attempt remains, or 'blocked' when no attempts remain. 'otp_sent' does NOT mean the caller is verified.

session_id.description: Session id returned when the call started.

full_name.description: Full name exactly as the caller said it. Honorifics are handled server side.

pan.description: PAN as spoken. Spaces and lower case are normalised server side.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key for this attempt. Reuse the same value when retrying after a timeout so the retry does not consume an extra verification attempt.

tools.name: verify_otp
tools.description: Check the passcode the caller read back from their phone. This is the step that actually verifies identity. Returns 'ok' when verified, 'retry' when the code was wrong or expired, or 'blocked' when no attempts remain.

code.description: The passcode exactly as the caller read it. Digits only; spaces are stripped server side.

tools.name: resend_otp
tools.description: Send a fresh passcode, retiring the previous one. Use when the caller did not receive the code or it expired. Capped per call and per customer.

tools.name: capture_lead
tools.description: Record a prospective customer's details for follow-up. Only valid after verify_identity returned 'not_registered'. These details are self-asserted and unverified, so this creates a lead for follow-up, never an application or a credit decision.

full_name.description: Full name as the caller says it.

pan.description: PAN as spoken; spaces and case are normalised.

email.description: Email address to send the application link to.

stated_monthly_income.description: Optional. Monthly income in rupees as stated.

tools.name: check_eligibility
tools.description: Run the credit policy and return the decision. Only valid after the passcode has been verified, not merely after the record was found. Never state an amount, rate, or instalment that did not come from this tool.

tenure_months.description: Repayment period in months, between 6 and 84.

declared_monthly_income.description: Monthly income in rupees as stated by the caller.

tools.name: record_consent
tools.description: Record the caller's agreement to the terms. Only valid after eligibility has been assessed. Pass the caller's actual words, not a summary.

granted.description: True only for a clear yes. Ambiguity is not consent.

verbatim_response.description: What the caller actually said, transcribed.

tools.name: escalate
tools.description: Transfer the call to a human and open a ticket. Callable at any point in the call. Always a valid choice.

summary.description: One or two sentences so the human does not have to start over.
